name: clash
description: Operate the complete local Clash creative workspace through CLI-compatible MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Run your local Clash workspace from Codex
interface.longDescription: Run Clash as a local-first Codex client. The plugin reuses the selected dev or production Desktop/local-api host when available, or starts its bundled local-api runtime on first use. Typed MCP tools operate on the same project. Compatible MCP clients can open the complete Project App; the former standalone mini Apps are disabled. External client App rendering requires separate acceptance.
